controls.name: Data-at-Rest Protection
controls.description: Data-at-rest is protected using cryptographic means in compliance with policies, requirements, and risk guidelines.
mitigations: Enforce Customer Managed Key encryption layers for long-term production buckets.
Govern security controls with active audit trackers.

controls.name: Data-in-Transit Protection
controls.description: Data-in-transit is protected to keep repositories and communications hidden from unsolicited interception.
mitigations: Enable S3 secure transport restrictions forcing HTTPS configurations.
Block public permissions on data storage buckets to eliminate leak risk.

controls.name: Network Ingress Controls and Boundary Defense
controls.description: Network boundaries are protected using access control gates and restricted ingress configurations.
mitigations: Reconfigure target firewalls to eliminate 0.0.0.0/0 ingress mapping profiles directly on Port 22/3389.
Adopt bastion servers or zero-trust connectors.
